new_news.headline: 2026 ESG & Compliance Dates and Sustainability Calendar
new_news.summary: Strategic ESG compliance calendar highlighting 2026 reporting deadlines and sustainability milestones. Includes alignment of food waste reduction and circular economy reporting with key sustainability frameworks and environmental dates.

new_news.headline: A perspective on transforming fats, oil, and grease (FOG) into hydrogen: insights on steam reforming catalysts and the case study of Hong Kong
new_news.summary: Research article exploring sustainable hydrogen production from FOG through steam reforming catalysts. Emphasizes FOG recycling's carbon capture potential and sustainable waste recovery supporting carbon neutrality targets, with a focus on case studies and lifecycle assessment.

new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. 1Q 2026 Results: Revenue $42.4K, Net Loss $6.18K
new_news.summary: Barrel Energy Inc. reported first-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $42.4K, a net loss of $6.18K and diluted EPS of $(0.01), compared with revenue of $45.14K, net income of $16.86K and EPS of $0.02 in the year-ago quarter. The accumulated deficit reached $317,010, and management disclosed 'substantial doubt' about continuing as a going concern without new funding.

new_news.headline: Renewable Diesel Industry Transformation Driven by Diamond Green Diesel and RFS Support
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients is the largest company in the world that collects, produces, and adds value to animal byproducts and used cooking oil. Following the finalization of RFS RVO policy, the company held an investor day to discuss its renewable fuels business model.
